name: Bass, Growl
description: A bass's growl at 700 Hz, for a line that disappears under the mix.

name: Guitar, Forward
description: Electric or acoustic guitar brought forward: a lift at 1 kHz and bite at 2 kHz.

name: Kick, Beater
description: The kick's boxiness at 300 Hz down and its beater at 3 kHz forward.

name: Mix, Gentle Scoop
description: A shallow dip at 500 Hz with a touch of presence: the middle of a busy mix cleared.

name: Snare, Crack
description: The cardboard at 700 Hz out and the crack at 4 kHz up.

name: Vocal, Body and Presence
description: A little chest at 200 Hz, the box at 500 Hz taken out, and presence at 3 kHz.

name: Vocal, Less Nasal
description: A dip at 1 kHz for a voice that sounds pinched or nasal.
